title: Average-Depth Variable Execution via Request-Local Token Routing
abstract: arXiv:2611.27738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Layer skipping can reduce large language model inference costs, but a request budget does not specify how to allocate layer execution across generated tokens. We introduce \method{}, which allows tokens to execute different numbers of layers while matching each request's mean executed depth to a continuous budget. At each routed layer, a router reads the current token state and its request's budget and decides whether to execute the Transformer block. Tokens that skip the block pass through a lightweight residual adapter and write no key/value (K/V) entry at that layer. A single checkpoint serves requests with different budgets in the same batch. Across three LLaMA backbones, six quality metrics, and 13 budgets, AVERT is best or tied for best in 206 of 234 comparisons. translated_title: 通过请求局部Token路由实现平均深度可变执行
translated_abstract: 层跳过可以降低大语言模型的推理成本，但请求预算并未规定如何在生成的Token之间分配层的执行。我们提出了AVERT方法，它允许不同的Token执行不同数量的层，同时将每个请求的平均执行深度匹配到连续预算上。在每个路由层，路由器读取当前Token的状态及其所属请求的预算，并决定是否执行该Transformer块。跳过该块的Token会通过一个轻量级残差适配器，并且在该层不写入键/值（K/V）缓存条目。单一检查点即可在同一批次中服务具有不同预算的请求。在三个LLaMA骨干模型、六个质量指标和13种预算的实验中，AVERT在234次对比中有206次取得最佳或并列最佳结果。在单预算和混合预算批次中，每个请求的平均绝对预算误差最多为1.15个百分点。当按预算对请求分组导致批次无法填满时（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出AVERT方法，通过请求局部路由让每个Token动态决定执行的Transformer层数，使请求的平均执行深度精确匹配连续预算，在降低大语言模型推理成本的同时保持输出质量，且单一检查点可同时服务不同预算的请求。
en_tdlr: AVERT enables variable-depth execution via request-local token routing, matching each request's mean executed depth to a continuous budget to cut LLM inference costs while preserving quality with a single checkpoint serving mixed-budget batches.
